claim: The circulating NEET UG Counselling 2026 percentile-reduction notice addressed by MCC on 13 October 2026 is genuine.
caption:
FAKE NOTICE — NEET UG COUNSELLING 2026

A circulating notice claimed a percentile reduction for NEET UG Counselling 2026. In its 13 October advisory, the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) called that notice fake and said no such reduction decision had been taken.

This check concerns that specific notice as addressed on 13 October—not current cut-offs or separate PG/MDS counselling rules. Verify current counselling information at mcc.nic.in.

Source: MCC official corrective advisory, published 13 October 2026:
https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e0f7a4d0ef9b84b83b693bbf3feb8e6e/uploads/2026/10/20261013881045664.pdf
Official listing: https://mcc.nic.in/news-events-ug-medical/
Checked: 30 October 2026.

AI-assisted research and design. AI illustration — not actual footage.
Independent automated evidence and visual review completed.
